text:
maya: Heads-up: ran the new int8 reranker bring-up against our prod-like eval mix. Overall token-level latency down ~20%, but short-query MRR dropped ~2.8 and ndcg@10 ~1.6. Long queries nearly flat.
otto: Can you paste slice defs? short means queries with <=4 tokens?
maya: short_queries = queries token_count <= 4, single-pass, top10 candidates. Dataset: mix of prod-sampled + synthetic tails (link: https://console.redwood/datasets/rerank/mix-v7). Artifacts uploaded: s3://bench-output/1721234567/int8_artifacts.tar.gz
priya: Any change in tokenizer/artifacts? quantization should be model-only but token offsets can bite.
maya: No tokenizer change. I verified token counts matched baseline. But noticed priming_template was different in the test-run (we added a small system priming to boost context) — suspect interaction with quant noise.
sam: Try disabling priming and run a quick smoke? Also try pad_to shorter value. For short queries, priming adds extra tokens and might change attention scaling when weights are quantized.
maya: Quick ablation: disable priming -> MRR improves by ~1.7 (so gap reduces to ~1.1 vs fp16). Changing pad_to from 64 to 32 (keeping priming) recovered ~1.2. So both matter.
otto: Interesting. Are flipped top-1s driving MRR? Or is it score calibration causing small swaps to affect metric?
maya: I computed pairwise swap rate between fp16 and int8 top5: ~2.5% flips for short_queries, top1 flips account for most of the MRR drop. For long_queries flips ~0.4%.
priya: Could be two things: quantization noise changes relative logits (ordering) or it shifts global scale (calibration). Did you try linear rescale of scores?
maya: Yes, scaling int8 logits by 1.015 improved ndcg ~0.4 and mrr ~0.5 but didn't fully close gap.
sam: Run targeted hybrid configs: keep final softmax layer fp16, or last 2 transformer blocks fp16, see if ordering stabilizes. Also try per-channel quant vs per-tensor; we historically saw per-channel helps attention-heavy tasks.
maya: Plan submitted: (1) int8 with hybrid-softmax (last linear + layernorm fp16), (2) int8 with last-2-blocks fp16, (3) per-channel quant calibration, (4) re-run candidate scoring with kvpack toggled. Queued jobs.
priya: Also assemble a human-judged short query goldset (2k) so product can eyeball flipped examples and we can run bootstrap CI.
bench-bot: job queued: 1721234601 - hybrid-softmax-run. ETA ~18m.
otto: For analysis: export the top-1 flipped examples (3 per bucket) and produce a confusion table showing which candidate ids swap. That helps triage whether it's consistent model-level ranking or noisy tail cases.
maya: Will export top-1 diffs + per-query tokenized views. Also will include logits before/after rescale.
sam: Small note: check softmax temperature empirically — quant noise can change effective temperature. Compute empirical entropy of softmax for fp16 vs int8 across slices.
maya: Good idea. Quick check: avg softmax entropy on short_queries is slightly higher for int8 (0.08 nats). Suggests smoothing.
priya: If hybrid-softmax reduces entropy gap, that's a good signal. If not, consider calibrating scores with a learned affine transform per-slice.
otto: Can we tolerate small MRR drop for 20% latency gain? Depends on customer SLAs and downstream QoE. If we can regain ~1% via hybrid and per-channel, net win.
maya: Console shows canary throughput improvement targets met. Product wants a canary tomorrow if we can guarantee p>0.05 that delta <= -0.5 on goldset.
sam: I'll draft rollback plan for canary: revert to fp16 variant, route 10% of traffic to int8 and monitor short_query mrr. Canary window 6h.
priya: Re-quant note: ensure calibration corpus includes short-query distribution; per-tensor calibration on long-doc corpus can bias scales.
maya: Action items: maya -> run hybrid + per-channel jobs and upload diffs; otto -> create 2k gold short-query set and run 10k bootstrap; priya -> implement per-channel re-quant prototype and entropy calc; sam -> canary + rollback doc. Will post updates here.
bench-bot: hybrid-softmax-run finished: job 1721234601. Summary: hybrid restored ~1.3 MRR and 0.7 ndcg on short_queries vs int8 baseline (still slightly below fp16). Full logs s3://bench-output/1721234567/hybrid_softmax_results/
maya: Nice. I'll pull the per-query flips now and attach 5 representative examples for product review. Will update thread when otto's goldset stats complete.
otto: Running bootstrap on goldset now (10k). Will report p-values and CI.
priya: If hybrid + per-channel gets us within 0.3 MRR of fp16, I'd be comfortable pushing to dedicated canary. Keep an eye on any slice regressions.
maya: Thanks team — posting artifacts shortly.
